contract: Frozen: ARCHITECTURE.md, this domain's contract.ts, src/core/ports.ts. Need a change: factory signal, take the reversible default. change: Sparkline (series SparkPoint[], ariaLabel, height number or 'fill', width, form line or area, reference number or 'mean', axisLabels [a,b,c], format, summary) and MiniBars (highlight number or 'last'). Interactive only when axisLabels is present; otherwise tabIndex -1, keyboard false, an image with a name. Line neutral, area fades to 0, now dot reads the private --spark-now var set by the frame. MiniBars: dim ink 34/38 percent, one lit, data-end radius 3 to 4, max 24, gap 2 to 4. No tone or color by type. Rule: none new. Skill: generated docs/sparkline.md and docs/mini-bars.md. Tests: ported sparkline suites, byte test, axe.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
